question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that reality in every place?
premises: The meditation is performed in place after place.
That reality is the object of meditation.
Its range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that reality in every place as pervading from Shiva to Avici.
